title: Expense Agent: travel request expense location, per-traveler reports, activity log and submitter comment
summary: The Expense Agent travel request feature now supports expense location selection using per diem rules, creates per-traveler expense reports on approval, logs the full request lifecycle, enables rejection with automatic reopen, and allows submitter comments for resubmissions.
key_points: Expense location field replaces three obsolete country/region fields and enforces location+date validation when per diem is enabled
Approving a travel request creates separate expense reports for each additional traveler, with employee validation and removal restrictions
Activity log tracks travel request lifecycle (created, submitted, resubmitted, approved, rejected) with separate entries for generated expense reports
Reject action reopens the request immediately so submitters can resubmit without a separate call
New submitTravelRequestWithComment action allows comments during resubmission, stored in read-only field
